title: El día que conocí a Sofía
blurbEn: The last text of the unit: a full story, with the scene in one tense and everything that happens in the other.
body:
Conocí a Sofía hace cuatro años, en una cafetería del centro.

Era una tarde de septiembre y hacía mucho calor. Yo estaba sentada al lado de la ventana y leía un libro de historia bastante aburrido.

Había mucha gente y no quedaban sitios libres. Sofía llegó, miró alrededor y me preguntó si podía sentarse en mi mesa.

Dije que sí. Ella pidió un café, sacó un cuaderno y empezó a escribir.

Después de diez minutos cerré el libro y empezamos a hablar. Estuvimos allí tres horas.

Desde entonces somos amigas.
translationEn:
I met Sofía four years ago, in a café in the centre.

It was a September afternoon and it was very hot. I was sitting next to the window reading a fairly boring history book.

There were a lot of people and no free seats were left. Sofía arrived, looked around and asked me if she could sit at my table.

I said yes. She ordered a coffee, took out a notebook and started to write.

After ten minutes I closed the book and we started talking. We were there for three hours.

We have been friends ever since.

Era.note: The whole second paragraph is scene-setting — afternoon, weather, where she sat, what she was reading. All imperfecto, not one event among them.

llegó.note: And here the story starts moving. Everything from this point is preterite.

Conocí.note: In the preterite 'conocer' means met for the first time. 'Conocía a Sofía' would mean I already knew her.

phrases.gloss: there were no free seats left
